payload.note: Full-Gibbs annealed signed-response one-loop reduction: corrected the off-fiber distance-two prefactor to exp(psi_y-2 psi_v), retained the conditional normalization and order-lambda background marginal, and reduced beta_L(lambda)=b_(2,L) lambda^2+O_L(lambda^4) to an exact hypercubic Fourier polynomial P. On the periodic 6^4 lattice the complete algebraic sum is b_(2,6)=-849547889/1849425177600<0, so annealing cancels most but not all of the negative vacuum defect and universal finite-volume beta_L>=0 is refuted at one loop. The all-volume formula converges to b_(2,infinity)=-85/5184+W4/18+5 I4/288; its sign awaits a rigorous Watson/Bessel interval. This does not prove heat-bath instability, an interacting H^-1 bound or failure, a continuum measure, or any Born, Krein, or Lorentzian claim.
